description: A salon that brings an intimate + creative vibe to GULF SHORES. Our goal is to create an environment that makes you feel at ease; a place we can connect and enhance each persons unique self by focusing on the beauty each of us holds and the gratitude we should all have being unique individuals. We are a team of artist who prioritize education, collaboration and excellence from start to finish.
